articles.summary: Topline Pro is a one-stop-shop AI platform to enable service professionals to get discovered, build trust, and get booked online. We are honored to be named on the 2023 SMBTech 50, created by GGV Capital in collaboration with Crunchbase and 27 venture capital firms to recognize the growth and potential of startups that serve small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Examples of other businesses in the top 50 include Service Titan, Stripe, and others.
articles.title: Topline Pro Awarded as a Top 50 SMB Tech Company for 2023
